title: Generative Collapse Dynamics (UMCP/GCD): Enabling Cross-Domain Comparability via Contract-Frozen Kernel Invariants and Typed Return
source_native_claims: Presents GCD as a contract-first measurement discipline governed by a single admissibility axiom: collapse is generative; only what returns through collapse is real — where "real" is an audit rule, not a metaphysical claim.
Formalizes the Tier-1 kernel ledger (F, ω, S, C, κ, IC, typed return delay τ_R) and proves the identities F+ω=1, IC≤F, IC=exp(κ).
